title: 有馬記念の後に・未来のために

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky does well at the Arima Kinen, but at the same time realizes Grass Wonder is a much bigger threat than she had anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides to run in the next race, the spring Tenno Sho, to retest her abilities. The incredible Special Week will also be running there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nearby, King Halo decides to walk her own path and proudly leaves the racecourse.
